TEST-ONLY CANARY EXAMPLE: every key that signed this bundle is a published test key.

Verify with an out-of-band trust root only: the export key fingerprint for
manifest.json.sig, and the receipt key for content/decision-bom.json.sig,
the receipt and any addenda. signing-key.pub and receipt-keys.json are
convenience copies, never the trust root.

This bundle carries no audit row payloads (ADR-0189 R39): audit/chain.tsv
holds hashes only, so the decision row's content is not disclosed.

vectors.title: no flushed anchor, floor anchored

anchor not yet flushed counts as no flushed anchor
tamper_resistant false, floor anchored

timestamps required and none granted, floor anchored
timestamps required and none granted, floor anchored_unverified_destination
retain_until null, floor anchored
retain_until not after the freeze time (equal), floor anchored
retain_until before the end of the evidence retention, floor anchored
retain_until before the end of the evidence retention, floor anchored_unverified_destination
retain_until equal to the end of the evidence retention: anchored (only 'before' is short)
everything recorded, floor anchored
unbounded retention, refuse, floor anchored_unverified_destination
unbounded retention, refuse, floor chain_signed
unbounded retention, refuse, floor anchored: pending with retention_unbounded
unbounded retention, accept, floor anchored: anchored_finite_lock freezes whatever the floor
unbounded retention, accept, floor chain_signed
timestamps required and granted, everything recorded

responseRules.title: the B4.6 report: every required check, fixed results, outcome valid_with_unverifiable
a non-invalid outcome missing the finality check
a Decision BOM outcome valid (impossible: decision_content_binding is always unverifiable)
a stored source reporting bundle_manifest_signature valid
a stored source reporting the bundle checks unverifiable not_a_bundle
a check reported twice without distinct non-null refs
a v2 receipt with receipt_facts_binding unverifiable receipt_v1_no_factsHash
a v1 receipt with receipt_facts_binding valid
anchor_absent on an anchored BOM's anchor checks
an invalid check with outcome valid_with_unverifiable (any invalid gives invalid)
a stored ai_bom_snapshot source used for a Decision BOM
spec: B4.4 'Required checks': stored source names its own subject (B4C-03)

responseRules.title: a missing required check with outcome invalid is admissible (a response missing one can only be invalid)
